Syllabus-based grading policy setup

/teach/courses/:courseId/grading-policy
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S19, S14

Translate the published syllabus into structured, versioned calculations with independently checkable learner examples.

Dialogs and drawers (2)
Apply grading policy
  • Syllabus reference, changed rules, impact count and examples
  • No released result changes until separate reviewed release
Return without applying changesApply working policy version
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Only instructor edits/applies policy or sees full-course impact; TA policy view is read-only with assigned examples.
  • TA cannot inspect other learners, private allowance basis or release payloads. Authoring grants do not confer policy authority.
Responsive
  • Wide web aligns category weights, mapping and old/new calculation previews; narrow web uses one category card at a time.
  • Keep total weight, represented active weight and stale-preview status visible near Apply; detailed arithmetic remains expandable text.
Accessibility
  • Label each percentage with category and each boundary with inclusive/exclusive meaning; errors link to the precise mapping/weight.
  • Offer arithmetic tables with captions and text equations. Announce changed validation totals; do not announce every keystroke or rely on chart colours.
Data
  • Versioned policy stores syllabus reference, mode, mappings, weights, status/empty rules, precision and boundaries; no allowance basis.
  • Instructor alone receives full-course impact preview. TA gets read-only policy and assigned examples; released learner projection remains pinned until W53.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Fixture: released PS1 24/30, PS2 27/30, PS3 excused, lab18/20, quiz8/10 →84.50%; held PS4 27/30 →staff85.17%, learner84.50%. Separately reconcile coworker10/25/25/40 scenario.
  • Reject 99.9% weights, duplicate mappings and overlapping letter bands.
  • All-excused/empty denominator displays No calculable grade, never NaN, zero or an invented letter.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
